four_way_comparison.predictions_summary: Mean linguistic confidence: 0.7721. Captures explicit semantic meaning of transcribed words.

four_way_comparison.limitations: Completely blind to vocal delivery, tone, prosody, volume, sarcasm, or acoustic emotion; strictly dependent on ASR accuracy; fails on non-speech audio; static representation.

four_way_comparison.modality_scope: Bimodal acoustic + linguistic fusion (50% Audio + 50% Text)

four_way_comparison.capabilities: Discovers cross-modal agreement and divergence; provides confidence arbitration when individual modalities are uncertain.
four_way_comparison.limitations: Evaluates the audio recording as a single static utterance; loses temporal progression, per-segment evolution, turn-taking, and emotional escalation over time.

four_way_comparison.modality_scope: Temporal segment-level bimodal fusion + conversation dynamics

four_way_comparison.capabilities: Captures emotional evolution over time, detects rising/falling intensity, identifies escalation across conversation turns, classifies conversation consistency trajectory, flags high-priority conversations for review with transparent heuristic, attributes turns to speakers.
four_way_comparison.limitations: Computationally heavier; requires multiple speech segments (minimum 2 segments for trajectory, minimum 3 segments for escalation); dependent on ASR segment timestamp boundaries.
